title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
summary: A CTO is the senior leader accountable for a company's technology. They set the technology strategy and architecture, build and lead the engineering organisation, own the technology budget and vendors, and report technology plans and risks to the CEO and board. In regulated firms they also answer to regulators for IT governance.
dailyDuties: Set the technology strategy and roadmap with the CEO
Own architecture decisions for core platforms
Build, lead and hire for the engineering organisation
Plan and control the technology budget and vendors
Review reliability, security and major incidents with the CISO
Report technology plans and risks to the board

skills.expectation: Set the technology strategy and multi-year roadmap
Own the architecture of core systems and platforms
Lead architecture choices and engineering standards
Build and lead the engineering organisation
Hire senior engineers and engineering leaders
Plan and control the technology budget
Report technology plans, risk and spend to the board
Work with the CEO, product and business heads
Work with the CISO on security strategy
Decide where AI fits in the product
Set how engineering plans and delivers
